title: Does the Judge See What the Evaluation Requires? Input Assurance for LLM Agent Evaluation
title_zh: 评审者是否看到了评估所要求的内容？面向LLM智能体评估的输入保障

paragraphs.en: 提出四项输入保障义务，发现渲染器遗漏工具调用导致LLM评审者在错误步骤上误判增多。 An LLM judge assesses agent steps from text packets. A renderer converts recorded runs into these packets, while software checkers test records and packets against requirements. We ask what evidence shows a packet is what the evaluation requires and propose four input-assurance obligations: required content survives rendering, checkers cover their requirements, a failed check stops later use and the judge reads the bytes last checked. In one pipeline with 30 trajectories, matching hashes, passing checkers and successful staging (copying packets for the judge) coexisted with violations of all four obligations, the last two in integration tests. The renderer omitted every structured tool call, leaving 53 of 60 judged steps blank despite matching hashes. For one judge configuration, later context raised error flags by 13 more on error than on correct steps. Restoring every call reduced this contrast to 2, a reduction of 11 (0.37 per trajectory, 95% cluster-bootstrap interval 0.17 to 0.53). In packets ending at the judged step, that configuration abstained at least once on every blank step, while the other four sometimes abstained but also flagged blank error and correct steps. Both separately written checkers accepted an unmatched tool result. In integration tests, a stub replacing the judge read a failed build's packet and a copy changed after staging. Three added controls stopped 18 of 19 constructed fault cases before the stub read any packet. The remaining stale script never ran. We turn the obligations into four tests and plan to evaluate their transfer to independent pipelines.
paragraphs.zh: 提出四项输入保障义务，发现渲染器遗漏工具调用导致LLM评审者在错误步骤上误判增多。 一个LLM评审者从文本包中评估智能体的步骤。 渲染器将记录的运行过程转换为这些文本包，而软件检查器则根据需求测试记录和文本包。 我们探讨何种证据能够表明文本包符合评估要求，并提出四项输入保障义务：所需内容在渲染后得以保留、检查器覆盖其对应需求、检查失败即停止后续使用、评审者读取最后被检查的字节。 在一个包含30条轨迹的流水线中，哈希匹配、检查器通过和成功的暂存（为评审者复制文本包）同时存在，却违反了全部四项义务，其中后两项出现在集成测试中。 渲染器遗漏了所有结构化工具调用，导致60个被评审步骤中的53个为空白，尽管哈希匹配。 对于某个评审者配置，后续上下文使错误步骤上标记错误标志的次数比正确步骤多出13次。 恢复全部工具调用后，该对比降至2，减少了11次（每条轨迹减少0.37次，95%聚类自助区间为0.17至0.53）。 在终止于被评审步骤的文本包中，该配置在每个空白步骤上至少弃权一次，而其他四个配置有时弃权，但也会标记空白的错误步骤和正确步骤。 两个分别独立编写的检查器都接受了一个不匹配的工具结果。 在集成测试中，替换评审者的桩读取了一个失败构建的文本包，以及一个在暂存后被更改的副本。 新增的三项控制在桩读取任何文本包之前，阻止了19个构造的故障用例中的18个。 剩余的过期脚本从未运行。 我们将这些义务转化为四项测试，并计划评估其在独立流水线上的可迁移性。
